title: Add installer update uninstall and repair flows

context.summary: Add safe local lifecycle operations for installed Mindory homes: update staging, backups, uninstall and repair/resume diagnostics.
context.background: The installer can now prepare, start and provision a first token. It needs lifecycle primitives before release bundling and public use.

in: Add update staging for config and Compose assets with rollback to previous files on failure.
Add uninstall that optionally creates a backup, runs compose down when requested and removes MINDORY_HOME only with explicit confirmation.
Improve repair and resume output using lock and journal state.
Expose CLI commands for update dry-run/apply and uninstall.
Validate lifecycle operations in temp homes without mutating real Docker.

acceptance_criteria: Update dry-run reports planned backup and asset replacement without mutation.
Update apply backs up current config/assets and rewrites prepare assets.
Update failure restores previous config/assets from backup.
Uninstall requires explicit confirmation and can create a backup before removing MINDORY_HOME.
Repair/resume summarize lock, journal and recommended next actions.
pnpm check validates lifecycle flows in temporary directories.

manual_checks: Confirm destructive uninstall is guarded by --yes.

risks: Uninstall must not remove paths outside the selected MINDORY_HOME.
Backups may include secrets and must stay under MINDORY_HOME/backups.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
